source: Proof row P8 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-22-zero-dependency-install-design.md), CI run 39806281902; identical on darwin-arm64, darwin-x64 and win-x64. tools/list values moved on 2026-10-24, see note
note: zod 3.25.76 -> 4.6.7 (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5). The MCP SDK turns zod 4 schemas into JSON Schema with zod's own converter, so the tools/list bytes changed: key order (description before type, $schema first) and the recursive importFromFigma layer schema now sits under definitions/__schema0 instead of a $ref to #/properties/layers/items. Semantically identical to the P8 payload for all 26 tools (same names, descriptions, properties, required lists, enums, additionalProperties false on every object), checked by sorting keys, dropping $schema and normalising the refs.
